shannal_benbyr_10.m: Here, take this bronze coin. It is a 'Traders' Guild Bronze coin' and the only one I have left, so don't lose it. Now, go show it to Benbyr. He generally can be found north of Fallhaven, keeping out of the sight of Feygard guards. He's a shifty character, so beware.
r: Why do I need to show this coin to Benbyr of all people?

shannal_benbyr_20.m: First step in restitution. Now go!

r: A very scared apple which didn't fall far from the tree. An ancestor who forced people to come to work here.

shannal_benbyr_40.m: I know. I was one of those people forcibly abducted by him. I lost my family. I lost my life here.
r: Do you intend to kill him?

shannal_benbyr_50.m: Benbyr? No, if I wanted, I could have harmed his predecessors. But I seek your help. Benbyr has to make restitution.

shannal_benbyr_55.m: Remember the drunk man outside the Fallhaven tavern?
r: Sure...he's the one always begging me for some mead.

shannal_benbyr_60.m: Yes, that sounds like him alright. His name is Rain. He came to Undertell seeking his ancestor, me, to find out where I disappeared to.

shannal_benbyr_65.m: The sights and sounds here broke his mind.
r: I know. He keeps babbling about treasure and dungeons and of course, getting more mead.

shannal_benbyr_70.m: Unnmir was with him when his mind broke on seeing Undertell. I feared Unnmir would abandon him. But he took him to Fallhaven, and tried to get the priest to heal him. To no avail. He fell into drinking and camping outside the tavern, when the guard threw him out.

shannal_benbyr_80.m: First shake down Benbyr for how much he can give you.

shannal_benbyr_85.m: Then please give my descendant one of Lodar's Potion of heightened senses and tell Rain that I am at peace. Unnmir didn't know it, but that potion helps heal the mind as well.

shannal_benbyr_90.m: Then give him what you got from Benbyr, to start his new life.

shannal_benbyr_95.m: [sternly] And don't keep any gold from Benbyr for yourself, else you'll not get into Undertell!
r: Wow! That's a lot, but I think I've got it all. Don't worry.

shannal_removes_barricades_10.m: Quite well done! Thank you for helping Rain.

shannal_removes_barricades_20.m: Remember, Undertell is a deep, fiery and confusing place...be alert, always.

shannal_removes_barricades_30.m: You may now pass. The path to Undertell is open. Fare the well, wanderer.

shannal_step_40.m: Now bring that coin that I just gave you to Benbyr.

shannal_undertell_10.m: You wanted to get into Undertell so much, then why are you still here? Go.

shannal_undertell_hs_11.m: How dare you come to me while wielding that weapon.

shannal_unfinished_business_10.m: Has the assignment I gave you been completed?

shannal_welcome_10.m: Who are you? Why have you come?
r: I am $playername. I have been seeking my brother Andor, who might have entered Undertell. Please let me pass.

shannal_welcome_20.m: Impossible! I control those barricades and I can assure you that nobody passed through them any time recently.
r: Regardless, I still want to pass through them.

shannal_welcome_30.m: If you want to get into Undertell, you shall have to prove your capability to go inside. There are plenty of ghosts here. I don't want you to join their ranks.
r: But look at me, I am a powerful and skilled fighter.

shannal_welcome_40.m: I know you are. Else I would not even consider asking you.
r: So, what do you want from me?

undertell_barricades.10: I asked Myrelis how to get the barricades to Undertell removed and he told me to meet his friend Shannal inside the beach-scene house.
undertell_barricades.20: I met Shannal and she said I had to prove myself before she would remove the barriers. She feared that I am not ready to enter Undertell.
undertell_barricades.40: Shannal gave me a special Traders' Guild bronze coin and asked me to show it to Benbyr north of Fallhaven.
undertell_barricades.60: A frightened Benbyr told me these coins were payments his ancestor received for kidnapping people to work in the mines of Undertell.
undertell_barricades.70: Benbyr asked me to help save him from Shannal.
undertell_barricades.80: Shannal told me she did not want to kill Benbyr. She wanted him to pay toward helping her descendant, the drunkard named Rain who sleeps outside the Fallhaven Tavern.
undertell_barricades.90: Shannal asked me to help cure Rain by giving him one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses and whatever I can get of value from Benbyr. But I should visit Benbyr first.
undertell_barricades.100: Benbyr offered me fifty gold to keep the matter quiet. I refused.
undertell_barricades.110: Benbyr then offered 500 gold. I still refused.
undertell_barricades.120: Benbyr became terrified and handed over 5000 gold.
undertell_barricades.130: I gave one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses to drunkard outside the Fallhaven tavern, and he remembered his time in Undertell.
undertell_barricades.140: I assured Rain that Shannal was at peace and gave him the 5000 gold Benbyr had given me. He told me to keep the money safe with Bela until his hangover passed.
undertell_barricades.150: I entrusted 4850 gold to Bela for safekeeping. She agreed to hold it.
undertell_barricades.160: Shannal thanked me for helping Rain and warned me to be careful. She removed the barricades in front of the entrance to Undertell.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
